verdict.rationale: Llama's docs highlight function calling and 'agent-optimized inference' (llama-docs-2, llama-docs-15) and market a 'multi-agent coding in your terminal' capability (llama-docs-12), showing the model is designed to be driven by natural-language prompts that trigger tool/agent actions. However, there's no first-party or independent evidence of a concrete end-user product (chat UI, agent framework) demonstrating reliable natural-language command execution in practice—only marketing language and model-level feature claims. missing for 10: hands-on demonstration of natural-language command execution driving real agent actions, independent verification of agentic reliability, and documentation of a full agent orchestration layer.
